item.text: I’ll first inspect the starter app and its local instructions, then shape the pet, caregiving interactions, and visual polish around the existing stack. I’ll keep all project work inside this directory and verify the running app on port 9199.

**Planning 3D pet app structure**
**Defining pet and title details**

The directory is empty, so I’m creating a small self-contained web app instead of adapting an existing framework. I’ll make the pet itself the centerpiece, with feeding and care actions that change its expression, animation, and status in a way you can see immediately.

The app files are in place. The required Portly status check hit a macOS “executable missing” launch error, so I’m checking the available local tooling and will use Portly if its CLI is usable from this environment.

item.text:
Built Cowdie as a self-contained pet care app with animated feeding, play, rest, and petting interactions, plus live hunger, happiness, and energy meters. The browser title and main heading are both **GPT-6**.

`pnpm run build` passes. I couldn’t verify it in a browser: Portly cannot launch because its app executable is missing, and the environment blocks Node from listening on port 9199. Dependency downloads also failed because DNS was unavailable.
